exact_lifecycle: A separately qualified private rotation creates the namespace binding and its original creation run. NativeRegistration seals the existing package/template; it does not reset that origin.

Producer authenticates each carried failure handoff and exact deduplicated reservation list, then reads at most four pages of five ordered unique matching dispatches. Stable totals, the original namespace run and every known failure writer must be present.

Every completed failure/cancellation/timeout newer than the origin must have an explicit carried handoff. Missing failures block before pending reservations are seeded and before normal private writes.

Successful capture/grade history stores the original authenticated operation metadata. Parent discovers the latest qualified successful history cohort and copies pending recovery from that original metadata into its next dispatch.

Parent rebuilds only five dynamic fields. The qualified-runtime binding, origin, original pending census and sealed prior-runtime relationship remain static. Recompressing handoffs/reservations preserves their bytes; it does not authenticate a new run-census baseline.

Failed runs preserve original controls/journals and a fresh reader restores failure evidence. Parent has no failed-run handoff discovery/absorption path; a failed run does not advance its successful history baseline.

The existing Owner rotation plus a newly sealed registration can establish a distinct qualified namespace while retaining the sealed prior runtime/history and complete census. Parent does not invoke that lifecycle automatically.
